packs.title: Confidence Pack
packs.tagline: A 7-day guided journey from self-doubt to steady self-belief.
packs.priceStub: NGN 1,500 (stub — no real charge in MVP)

days.body: Confidence does not start with feeling ready. It starts with telling the truth about where you are and taking one honest step.
days.action: Write down one true strength you already have.
days.reflection: Where does self-doubt speak loudest for you right now — and what is one true fact that answers it?

days.body: Fear lists what could go wrong. Confidence lists what you have already survived. Your track record is stronger than your worry.
days.action: List three hard things you have already handled.
days.reflection: Pick one past win — how did you earn it, step by step?

days.body: You do not build confidence in one leap. You build it in small reps done daily, especially when no one is watching.
days.action: Do the smallest version of your habit today — 2 minutes counts.
days.reflection: What 2-minute rep would prove to yourself that you show up?

days.body: Your voice deserves room. Say one honest thing today — kindly, clearly — instead of shrinking to keep the peace.
days.action: Say one honest sentence you have been holding back.
days.reflection: What would you say if you were not afraid of being judged?

days.body: A bad day is data, not a verdict. Name what happened in one sentence, keep the lesson, and release the shame.
days.action: Write what this week taught you in one sentence.
days.reflection: What is the lesson — and what will you try differently once?

days.body: Stand tall, breathe slowly, and let your body remind your mind: you are safe to try. Calm is a form of courage.
days.action: Stand tall, breathe deeply 5 times, state one strength aloud.
days.reflection: Notice your body right now — where is tension, and what does it need?

days.body: You showed up for seven days. Confidence is not loudness — it is the quiet trust that you will keep going. Take that with you.
days.action: Thank one person who believed in you — then set your next target.
days.reflection: What changed in you across these 7 days? Write it to your future self.
